clue.text: Feline in street showing hesitation gets hit on head and becomes forgetful

indicators.note: the cat word sits inside the street abbreviation, as the clue says the feline is in the street

parts.note: a feline is a cat
er is the sound of someone hesitating
to brain someone is to hit them on the head, so brained means hit on the head

explanation.surface: A cat wandering in the road dithers, gets clobbered and ends up dazed and absent-minded.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone disorganised and absent-minded is commonly called scatterbrained; the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: Study rigorous contract

parts.note: to con is an old word for study or pore over
strict means rigorous or exacting

explanation.surface: Examine a demanding agreement closely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contract' looks like a noun after 'rigorous', but it is the verb, meaning to tighten or narrow.
explanation.definitionFit: To contract is to squeeze or tighten, which is what constricting means; both are verbs of narrowing.

clue.text: Compare notes about boxing item for printer

indicators.note: about signals turning round, so the boxed letters are read backwards
boxing means enclosing, so the letters sit inside the words Compare notes

explanation.surface: A suggestion to share findings about a printer cartridge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boxing' picks RENOT from inside 'compaRE NOTes', and 'about' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Laser printers and copiers use toner powder, a cartridge of which is a standard printer consumable.

clue.text: Typical EU confusion finds Flora in Oz

indicators.note: confusion signals the letters of the words before it are mixed up into a new order

explanation.surface: A jab at the European Union's typical muddle, oddly finding Australian plants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confusion' scrambles TYPICALEU. Oz is informal for Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: Gum trees are native Australian plants, so the plural of the gum-tree genus fits plant life found in Australia.

clue.text: German in uncovered boat

indicators.note: in tells us the German letter goes inside the word for uncovered

parts.note: bare means uncovered or naked

explanation.surface: A German man found aboard an open-topped boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A barge is a flat-bottomed boat used on rivers and canals, an example of a vessel.

clue.text: A crew Independent draws in conveniences

parts.note: a crew is a group of men
draws are tied games, so ties

explanation.surface: A newspaper's staff take to the toilets.
explanation.walkthrough: Conveniences is a British euphemism for public toilets, which colours the surface; the definition is the wider sense of useful facilities.
explanation.definitionFit: Amenities are useful facilities such as shops or toilets, which is what conveniences also means.

clue.text: Ingenuous knight I embraced in greeting

parts.note: N is the chess notation for a knight

indicators.note: embraced in means held inside, so I goes within the greeting word

parts.note: ave is the Latin greeting hail

explanation.surface: An innocent knight is hugged during a welcome.
explanation.definitionFit: Ingenuous means innocent and unsophisticated, a close synonym of unworldly and trusting.

clue.text: Stray female cat losing head for day

indicators.note: the first letter of the cat word is lost and replaced by the day letter

parts.note: a tigress is a female big cat

explanation.surface: A wandering tigress loses her head for a day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stray' looks like an adjective for the cat but is the verb, to wander off the subject.
explanation.definitionFit: To digress is to wander from the main subject, a figurative straying.

clue.text: Person employing lawyer with legal right to appear in court

indicators.note: to appear in means the legal-right word shows up inside the court abbreviation

parts.note: a lien is a legal right to hold property until a debt is paid

explanation.surface: A litigant who has the right to be heard in court.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who engages a solicitor or barrister is that professional's customer, the usual word for it.

clue.text: Sheets etc made by rank nationalist

parts.note: a rank is a line, as of soldiers

explanation.surface: Bedding produced by a fervent patriot.
explanation.definitionFit: Bed sheets, pillowcases and tablecloths are collectively called household linen.

clue.text: Reprimand cover on floor

definitions.meaning: a severe telling-off; being called on the carpet means being summoned for a reprimand
fitted floor covering made of woven fabric

explanation.surface: Telling someone off about the floor covering.
explanation.definitionFit: A dressing-down is informally called this, and the word also means rugs and floor coverings in general.

clue.text: Uncovered unearthly shimmering charm

indicators.note: shimmering suggests flickering movement, so the remaining letters are rearranged
uncovered means the outer letters are stripped from the next word

explanation.surface: An exposed, otherworldly glimmer that casts a spell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Uncovered' removes the first and last letters of 'unearthly' to leave NEARTHL, which 'shimmering' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: To charm someone is to captivate them, the same as holding them spellbound.

clue.text: I have returned to shelter containing unknown harmful power

indicators.note: returned means the contraction of I have is read backwards

parts.note: the contraction of I have is I've

indicators.note: containing means the shelter word holds the unknown letter inside

parts.note: lee is the sheltered side, away from the wind
Y is a mathematical unknown

explanation.surface: Someone back home finds a sinister force hiding in a refuge.
explanation.definitionFit: A malevolent gaze believed to cause harm is a supernatural power in folklore, hence harmful power.

clue.text: Suffers after time in shadows

indicators.note: after puts the suffering word behind the time letter

parts.note: ails means is ill, suffers

explanation.surface: A sufferer struggles on after a spell in darkness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shadows' looks like a noun but is the verb: to follow someone secretly.
explanation.definitionFit: To shadow a suspect is to follow them covertly, which is what a detective who tails does.

clue.text: Seats on stylish transport

parts.note: seats are spaces, places to sit
hip means fashionable or stylish

explanation.surface: Places to sit on a chic vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A craft that carries people through outer space is an example of a means of transport.

clue.text: Outline to accommodate labour advisers in space surrounding building

indicators.note: to accommodate means the outline word holds the advisers inside it

parts.note: a precis is a summary or outline
the NCT, National Childbirth Trust, is a UK charity advising parents on labour and birth

explanation.surface: A plan drawn up to house union consultants in a building's grounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'labour' suggests trade unions, but means childbirth: the NCT is a British charity that runs antenatal classes.
explanation.definitionFit: The precincts of a cathedral or college are the enclosed grounds around it.

clue.text: Freedom of divorcee feeling without love but gaining power

parts.note: a divorced partner is an ex

indicators.note: without signals the love letter is dropped from the feeling word
but gaining means the power letter comes in where the other went out

parts.note: emotion is feeling
love is zero in tennis, so O

explanation.surface: A divorced person's sentiment, loveless yet empowered.
explanation.definitionFit: An exemption is release from a duty or rule, a form of freedom from obligation.

clue.text: Depressed after attempt to provide stern enforcement

indicators.note: after places the depressed word behind the attempt word

parts.note: to have a crack at something is to attempt it
down means low or depressed

explanation.surface: Feeling low after a try at imposing strict rule.
explanation.definitionFit: A clampdown on wrongdoing is a firm imposition of rules, the meaning of severe enforcement.

clue.text: Run papers back to heads of the embassy to send for trial overseas

parts.note: in cricket a run scored without the bat, such as a bye, is an extra

indicators.note: back means the papers abbreviation is read in reverse

parts.note: ID stands for identity papers

indicators.note: heads of means the first letters of the next two words

explanation.surface: A fugitive rushes documents back to embassy chiefs to be sent abroad for trial.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Run' suggests fleeing, but is a cricket extra, a run not scored off the bat.
explanation.definitionFit: Extradition is handing a suspect to another country to be tried there.

clue.text: Eased unevenly around headland and broke free

indicators.note: around means those letters surround the headland word
unevenly picks the odd-numbered letters of the word Eased

parts.note: a cape is a headland jutting into the sea

explanation.surface: A ship rounding a promontory in fits and starts, then getting away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unevenly' takes the 1st, 3rd and 5th letters of 'Eased', giving ESD.
explanation.definitionFit: To get away from captivity is to break free, both meaning fled or got out.

clue.text: Sun affected rascal

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for Sunday or sun
camp means affected or exaggerated in manner

explanation.surface: A scoundrel touched by sunshine.
explanation.definitionFit: A scamp is a mischievous rogue, a playful word for a rascal.

clue.text: Minister to the passions of prince and queen

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

explanation.surface: A government official serving royal couple's desires.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Minister' looks like a noun, but is the verb, to attend to.
explanation.definitionFit: To pander is to indulge or gratify the desires of others, often base ones.

clue.text: Worry about five in court for distribution

indicators.note: about means the worry word goes around the Roman five

parts.note: care is worry or anxiety
V is the Roman numeral five
to be up before a judge is to be in court

explanation.surface: Concern over five people standing trial about how something is shared.
explanation.definitionFit: Dividing spoils among parties, often unfairly, is a share-out, an informal word for distribution.

clue.text: Considers costs

definitions.meaning: to rate something is to judge or consider it
charges or prices, as in hotel tariffs

explanation.surface: Weighs up the prices.
explanation.definitionFit: The word serves both as a verb for judging or regarding and as a noun for fixed charges.

clue.text: God starts to punish lying, untrustworthy, thieving oligarchs

indicators.note: starts to means the first letter of each following word is taken

explanation.surface: A deity begins punishing dishonest, thieving plutocrats.
explanation.definitionFit: Pluto was the Roman god of the underworld, so he is an example of a god.

clue.text: Force family to produce fruit

parts.note: to pump is to force fluid along
kin are family or relatives

explanation.surface: Pressure relatives into producing fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: This large orange gourd is botanically a fruit, the seed-bearing part of the plant.

clue.text: Note going up and down

definitions.note: the musical note lasting two beats, a half note, whose five letters read the same either way

indicators.note: in a down clue going up and down means the word reads the same both ways

parts.note: the musical note lasting two beats, a half note, whose five letters read the same either way

explanation.surface: A musical note that rises and falls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going up and down' suggests a melody, but means the word is the same read upwards or downwards in the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: A minim is a musical note held for two beats, a half note in American usage.

clue.text: Area of land left in agreement from France to produce essential oil

parts.note: a patch is a small area of land

indicators.note: in puts the left letter inside the French agreement word

parts.note: oui is French for yes

explanation.surface: A plot of land abandoned under a French deal yields a fragrant oil.
explanation.definitionFit: Patchouli is an aromatic oil from an Asian herb, used in perfumery and aromatherapy.

clue.text: Snare returned before long to head of estate

indicators.note: returned means the assembled letters are read backwards
head of means the first letter of estate

parts.note: before long means soon

explanation.surface: A trap brought back to the estate manager shortly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' reverses ESOON, built from E (the head of 'estate') with SOON attached.
explanation.definitionFit: A loop of rope that tightens when pulled is used as a snare for catching animals.

clue.text: Detective's date is anticlimax

parts.note: DI is a Detective Inspector, so detective's gives DI's
a date is an appointment

explanation.surface: An inspector's romantic evening falls flat.
explanation.definitionFit: An anticlimax is a letdown after expectation, which is exactly a sense of being let down.
